sources.title: Maverick Doctrine
sources.reason: Defines Maverick as earned Shift4 performance, not case-admin. This should shape every cockpit interaction.

sources.title: Maverick SOP
sources.target: Phase 3 adapter and Phase 5 integration rules
sources.reason: Contains operating boundaries, broken-field warnings, write policy, and delivery surfaces. Reference now; distill into code contracts later.

sources.title: Maverick v2 Requirements
sources.reason: Captures the user's original functional requirements for memory, escalation, accountability, timing, email, and Omi.

sources.title: Maverick v2 Gap Analysis
sources.reason: Separates current capability, buildable-now work, and decisions that require confirmation.

sources.title: Argo Shift4 Dine Environment
sources.target: Bot Dispatch, priority engine, and 14-day handling rule
sources.reason: Defines the new bot layer, quick replies, Zapier spine, daily command stack, and case-handling doctrine.

sources.title: Buddy Mainframe
sources.target: Canvas Map and Launch Team board orientation
sources.reason: Connects the bot/mainframe surface to the Launch Team data source grouped by Task Status.

sources.title: Portfolio Reconciliation - 2026-04-22
sources.reason: Provides the 172-account reconciliation and close/good/reactivate/hold buckets.

sources.title: Burndown Sheet Operations Board
sources.target: Case Radar examples and reactivation queue
sources.reason: Lists concrete MID/DBA examples for close, active-good, move-to-active, and hold lanes.

sources.title: Launch Team Property Map
sources.reason: Verified property names, types, and select options are required for safe Notion normalization and future write gates.

sources.title: Agent Property Bindings
sources.reason: Maps agent responsibilities to read/write fields and human-approval requirements.

sources.title: Autonomous Satellite Contract
sources.target: Phase 3 case ledger and Phase 5 adapters
sources.reason: Defines the read-only module pattern, local state ownership, drafts-only behavior, and heartbeat seam.

sources.title: Maverick Base Module
sources.reason: Existing read-only cache and property extraction pattern should be lifted only after normalizing for the new schema.

sources.title: Casebook Satellite
sources.reason: Already implements per-case memory; should be inspected and adapted instead of rewritten blind.

sources.title: Timing Satellite
sources.reason: Contains 24-48h, QA same-day, and timezone logic aligned with cockpit timing needs.

sources.title: Accountability Satellite
sources.reason: Persists a daily accountability queue; cockpit should make it visible before any write-back.

sources.title: Escalation Satellite
sources.reason: Existing escalation detection should feed risk signals while writes remain confirmation-gated.

sources.title: Slack Signal Watch Runbook
sources.reason: Read-only Slack contract and active-account matching rules are authoritative.

sources.title: Slack Signal Watch Config
sources.reason: Defines channel IDs, active window, risk keywords, dedupe, and no-Slack-write rule.

sources.title: Signal Inbox Consumer and Schema
sources.reason: Existing routed packet consumer can become the cockpit's read-side signal ingestion pattern.

sources.title: Shift4 Email Reference
sources.reason: Durable standing-rules destination for Shift4 email memory.

sources.title: Merchant Outreach Guide
sources.reason: Contains outreach phrasing and should inform drafts without enabling send automation.

sources.title: Legacy HTML Interfaces
sources.reason: Prior HTML surfaces are useful references, but the cockpit should be built as a cohesive dashboard rather than copied.

sources.title: Legacy Runtime State
sources.reason: State caches and live runtime files should not be migrated as canon; rebuild state from adapters and ledgers.

sources.title: iCloud Drive Destination
sources.reason: Destination is registered, but writing requires a local mounted folder path or authenticated access.

sources.title: Gmail Connector
sources.reason: Mailbox and access method need confirmation before read/draft integration.

sources.title: Google Calendar Connector
sources.reason: Read rules and calendar source-of-truth need mapping before adapter work.
